@@ -0,0 +1,411 @@ +# Decision: web rendering — assertion → Tailwind mapping + +- **Date:** 2026-11-09 +- **Status:** decision record — no implementation is included in this change. +- **Issue:** [#5851](https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/5851), + "id: design: web rendering: assertion → Tailwind mapping (from #5679)". +- **Parent design:** [#5679](https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/5679) + ("Markup & styling model for programs-as-websites — semantic markup, + style-override mapping"), the web-target bullet of its style-override + mapping section. Programme: + [#2056](https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/2056). +- **Vocabularies consumed:** + [#5849](https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/5849) — semantic + markup vocabulary v1, landed as + `doc/2026-11-08_decision_id5849_semantic_markup_vocabulary_v1.md` + (PR #7923). Element kinds here are that registry's names; a later + vocabulary version that renames kinds re-issues §2's row labels only. + [#5850](https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/5850) — the + style-assertion vocabulary, settled in that issue's decision content + (task 12817, §§1–12). Its §12 names this ticket as the consumer of + its §§3–9 for the web mapping table. This record is that table, plus + the cascade, raw-CSS, and raw-HTML decisions the parent left to it. +- **Sibling precedents:** + [#5852](https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/5852) + (`doc/2026-11-08_decision_id5852_native_rendering_os_standard_controls.md`, + PR #7912) and + [#5853](https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/5853) + (`doc/2026-11-08_decision_id5853_custom_gui_rendering_overrides.md`, + PR #7684) — each mapping table states its assumptions against + unsettled inputs explicitly rather than parking; this record follows + that precedent (§1). + [#5854](https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/5854) + (`doc/2026-11-08_decision_id5854_per_target_composition.md`, PR #7864) + — the five-layer cascade this record adopts verbatim (§4). +- **Pipeline boundary:** + [#5855](https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/5855), whose + decision record (`doc/2026-11-08_decision_id5855_rendering_pipeline_conformance.md`) + is open in review (PR #7921) at the time of writing, owns the + five-stage pipeline (parse→validate→compose→lower→emit), the + compile-time-dominant split, and the conformance corpus shape. Mapping + tables are *data* to its lowering stage. This record defines that + data for the web target; it does not redefine the pipeline, the + report format, or the corpus gates (§1, assumption A4). +- **Evidence baseline:** `origin/main` at `1cd22df899`, worktree + `/home/user/git/fleet/12822`, 2026-11-09. Verified at that baseline, + consistent with triage tasks 10254 (2026-11-05) and 12343 + (2026-11-08): issue #5851 is open with no hard-stop labels, no PR + references it, and no assertion→Tailwind decision record exists in + `doc/`. The in-tree web styling infra is + `pkgs/web-gen-api-axum/css/tailwind.config.js` with an empty + `theme.extend`, no plugins, and content globs over `*.html` plus + `**/*.rs` (with an `rs` extractor mapping Rust `C::…`/`M::…` consts + to class spellings). + +## Decision summary + +| Question | Decision | +| --- | --- | +| What a semantic element becomes on web | A fixed DOM element per registry kind (§2) — the element's own tag carries semantics; styling never changes the tag | +| What an assertion becomes on web | Tailwind utility classes generated from theme keys, one source of truth in the theme file (§3). Content never names a utility, colour, or size (§7.1) | +| Which theme keys must exist | The §3.7 key list under `theme.extend` (colours, type steps, spacing, radii, shadows); missing keys are coverage warnings, never silent fallbacks (§7.6) | +| How generated classes reach Tailwind | The build emits the generated class set explicitly (safelist/data path, §3.8) — content-scanning alone cannot see classes no author wrote | +| Cascade position of everything | Adopted verbatim from #5854: platform defaults → theme/token values → semantic assertions → override map → raw CSS web-only, per-property (§4). Nothing here re-orders it | +| Raw CSS on web | Layer 5, wins per-property over assertion-derived utilities, every override listed in the composition report; cascade layering, never `!important` escalation (§5) | +| Raw HTML on web | `` passes through verbatim inside the web artefact, sanitised per #5785 contexts; `` is appended as layer 5. Both are greppable and enumerated in the coverage report (§6) | +| States | #5850 §5 state set and precedence, composed as Tailwind variants; focus-visible is never suppressible (§3.6) | +| Dark / high-contrast | `dark:` variant plus forced-colors variants keyed to the #5850 §10.8 variant requirement (§3.1) | + +## 1. Assumptions against unsettled inputs (stated, not silent) + +Parent issue #5679 is open with no settled decision record, #5850's +decision lives in an issue comment rather than a `doc/` record, and +#5855's record is open in review (PR #7921). Following the packet for +this ticket and the #5852/#5853/#5854 precedent, this record states its +assumptions instead of waiting: + +- **A1 — the parent model as written today.** Semantic markup describes + intent; styling is semantic style assertions over named roles; each + target renders assertions in its own idiom. Where the parent posed + an open either/or that this ticket must close (raw-CSS cascade + position, raw-HTML mixing), the sections below pick a branch and say + so. Anything that would change a parent decision is named out of + scope in §9, not decided here. +- **A2 — element kinds are the landed #5849 registry.** The 32-element + closed registry (§2 row labels) is fixed input. A vocabulary version + change that renames kinds re-issues §2's rows, not its decisions. +- **A3 — the #5850 vocabulary as written.** Dimensions are the closed + v1 set (tone, emphasis, density, text, gap, pad, corner, elevation); + colour/type/state/spacing roles are #5850 §§3–6; one `assert` + attribute per element; no raw values in source. No role is added, + removed, or renamed here. If #5850's rows change, §§2–3 are + re-issued against the new names. +- **A4 — the #5855 pipeline shape as written.** Parse→validate→ + compose→lower→emit, compile-time-dominant, deterministic + (same source + tables + toolchain ⇒ byte-identical output), mapping + tables as lowering data, JSON composition/coverage report. This + record supplies the web mapping data; it redefines nothing about + the pipeline or its reports. If PR #7921 lands with a changed + shape, only the data-format binding in §3.8 is re-issued. +- **A5 — the in-tree Tailwind setup as found.** `theme.extend` is + empty today: §3.7's key list is a requirement on the theme file, + not a description of it. The `rs` extractor convention (Rust + `C::…`/`M::…` consts → class spellings) is the existing mechanism + generated class names must remain compatible with. +- **A6 — no parent or sibling decision is changed.** The cascade is + #5854's; the platform-conflict rule is #5850 §8's (platform wins + for behaviour/accessibility; assertion wins for identity subject + to platform clamps — on web, "platform" means UA defaults, + accessibility media features, and forced-colors); native/GUI + mappings are #5852's/#5853's and untouched here. + +## 2.
